strategies.title: Strategies
strategies.description: Browse every strategy package. Open a card to manage prompts, schedules, files, runs, and tuning.

selfEvolution.title: Self Evolution
selfEvolution.description: Follow how Nerya turns runtime signals into proposals, validation gates, outcomes, and reusable learning assets.
selfEvolution.noMatchTitle: No signal, proposal, or asset matched the current filter.
selfEvolution.noMatchSubtitle: Start by collecting signals, then run a reflection pass to convert repeated patterns into proposal-first changes.
selfEvolution.historyDesc: Newest first. Select a row to inspect why it happened, what evidence exists, and what the next governed step is.
selfEvolution.selectRow: Select a history row to inspect its evidence chain.
selfEvolution.genesDesc: Reusable learning units selected by future memory recall and self-evolution runs.
selfEvolution.noAssetsSubtitle: Promoted capsules and custom genes will appear here.
selfEvolution.candidatesDesc: Promotion records an event and never mutates protected runtime scopes.
selfEvolution.noCandidatesSub: Asset candidates will appear after reflection, proposal outcomes, or memory gates.
selfEvolution.openProposalsEmptySub: Reflection and tuning produce proposal-first changes here before any apply step.
selfEvolution.openProposalsDesc: Review state, validation plan, evidence refs, and target before using the governed apply flow.
selfEvolution.evolutionGatesDesc: Current runtime guardrails. The dashboard displays policy state; mutating runtime config still belongs in Settings or proposals.
selfEvolution.evidenceRequiredDesc: Low-value memories stay as events, not persistent learnings.
selfEvolution.secretGuardDesc: Potential secrets are blocked from learning assets.
selfEvolution.validationDryRunDesc: Dashboard validation inspects plans and allowlists only.
selfEvolution.shellExecutionDesc: Actual validation command execution remains disabled here.
selfEvolution.perStrategyDesc: Self-evolution tuning is configured in each strategy package.
selfEvolution.rawEnvelopeDesc: Debug-only payload behind the operator view.
selfEvolution.enterStrategyFirst: Enter a strategy_id before running a tuning dry-run.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Configure trading accounts (CEX, DEX, perps, on-chain) with mode/permissions/limits/credentials. Multi-exchange + multi-paper + on-chain wallets all live here.
accounts.allAccountsDesc: One row per AccountProfile. Click the id to open the driver page.
accounts.noAccounts: No accounts configured yet. Click + Add account.
accounts.resetPaperTitle: Wipe paper trading state and reset balance
accounts.resetPrompt:
Reset paper sandbox for {id}?

This wipes orders / fills / positions / reservations / snapshots / executor runs for the account, and resets the virtual ledger. Strategy bindings stay.

Initial balance (USD) — leave blank to keep current:

Account {id} still has {orders} order(s) / {positions} position(s) / {executors} executor(s).

Force reset anyway?

accountDetail.resetPaperTitle: Wipe paper trading state and reset balance
accountDetail.permissionsLimitsDesc: What this account is allowed to do, and the per-account guard rails.

accountDetail.noCredentials: No credentials bound (paper or shadow account).
accountDetail.httpAuthHeadersDesc: Custom auth headers for data-source / REST connectors. Plaintext keys are refused — store the secret with /security/secrets/put first and reference it as vault://<name>.
accountDetail.walletPortfolioDesc: Live balances pulled from the bound on-chain wallet provider. Configure addresses under provider_config.balances on the account row.
accountDetail.noWalletSnapshot: No wallet snapshot yet — install the wallet provider, log in, and configure provider_config.balances.
accountDetail.recentOrdersDesc: Latest order tracker rows for this account.
accountDetail.reconciliationDesc: Severity-tagged drift reports for this account.
accountDetail.rawProfileDesc: Full account row as stored in accounts/accounts.yml.
accountDetail.headerRequired: Header key and value are required. Use vault://<name> to reference a secret stored via /security/secrets/put.
accountDetail.resetPaperPrompt:

This wipes orders / fills / positions / reservations / snapshots / executor runs for the account, and resets the virtual ledger. Strategy bindings stay.

addAccountForm.description: Paste exchange keys directly here or use existing vault:// refs. The API stores plaintext in SecretVault first and persists only vault refs to accounts.yml.
addAccountForm.submitModeTitle: Apply now writes accounts.yml directly. Propose stages a reviewable account_roster_patch.
addAccountForm.baseCurrencyTitle: Quote currency the dashboard uses to format balances. CEX accounts usually use USDT/USDC; A-share/CN brokers use CNY; on-chain wallets pin to whichever stablecoin the venue settles in.
addAccountForm.canaryLiveNeeds: canary/live needs this set + vault credentials
addAccountForm.withdrawPinned: is hard-pinned to false by Nerya core — it's never opt-in via this form.
addAccountForm.canAddManualSlots: You can still add manual credential slots.
addAccountForm.liveRequiresCred: live/canary requires at least one API key or vault:// credential
addAccountForm.paperCanEmpty: paper/shadow accounts can leave this empty
addAccountForm.noVaultRefs: No existing vault refs yet. Pasted plaintext will be converted automatically on submit.

exchangeAuthor.title: Add exchange (exchange_author)
exchangeAuthor.description: 4-step guided flow: pick venue → fill metadata → scaffold provider spec → approve. The skill writes a draft to workspace/providers/<venue_id>/ and only activates after approval.
exchangeAuthor.ccxtDesc: Select an exchange already supported by the ccxt library ({count} known).
exchangeAuthor.httpDesc: Author a brand-new venue by describing its REST endpoints — Nerya will scaffold a connector.
exchangeAuthor.notesPlaceholder: Why this venue, who approved, etc.
exchangeAuthor.stagedSpecDesc: The skill staged a provider spec. Review it on disk if you want, then approve to activate. After approval, an operator (you) can store API credentials via Settings → Integrations and bind them to a new account in the Accounts page.
exchangeAuthor.nowAvailableNext: is now available as a venue. Next:
exchangeAuthor.stepStoreKey: Store API key/secret via Settings → Integrations → put.
exchangeAuthor.stepAddAccount: Add an account on this page referencing the new venue.
exchangeAuthor.stepPromote: Set the account to paper first, validate, then promote through shadow → canary → live.
